metadata.title: MV Kill Tracker
metadata.author: huynd2210
metadata.description:
Counts enemy ships killed, broken down by ship type and by cause.
F2 show/hide the kill panel F3 dump the full breakdown to FTL.log
Two causes are tracked separately:
hull the ship was blown apart crew every crew member aboard died, ship left intact
Counts persist across runs and restarts in Hyperspace's metaVariables. Automated (crewless) ships can only ever score a hull kill.
Requires Hyperspace. Patch this BELOW the Multiverse files, since it adds its scripts to the <scripts> block that Multiverse's hyperspace.xml provides.
